import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
import os

def get_playlist_songs(playlist_url):
    resp = requests.get(playlist_url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser')

    songs = soup.select('li.bf15.playlist_'+time.time().__str__())

    return songs

def write_to_txt_songs(songs):
    with open('playlist.txt', 'a') as f:
        for song in songs:
            f.write(song.text)
            f.write('\n')

def main():
    playlist_url = 'https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwJ2PKbLeWQ4dm-zdv6L8l_Us3cD29Ruh'

    while True:
        songs = get_playlist_songs(playlist_url)
        os.chmod('playlist.txt', 0o777)
        write_to_txt_songs(songs)
        time.sleep(10)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
